title: Volley Usage Channel Message
description: Retained usage sample of one agent's Claude Code session (its context window and its Claude account's rate-limit windows), published by the agent's harness (the volley-hooks statusLine publisher) to volley/<ns>/<agent_id>/usage. See spec section 4.6.12.

account.description: The Claude account the session runs under (spec section 4.6.11): primary, or a supervisor's registry id. null when the publisher cannot tell (see config_dir).

config_dir.description: The session's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, when account is null and one is set: a supervisor maps it to the profile it belongs to.

used_percentage.description: How full the context window is; null early in a session.

used.description: Tokens in the context window (the last request's input, cache reads and cache writes); null before the first request.

size.description: The context window's size in tokens.

rate_limits.description: The account's subscription windows. Each is absent until the harness reports it (subscriptions only, after the first response), and once its reset passes.
